gap_2_isogenic_variance_floor.acquisition_path: add_dataset (download Cell Reports 2021 supp morphometric CV table [+ optionally GSE153621 per-embryo counts]) -> genes via resolve_id -> §7.9 cache -> human review -> approve_dataset -> ingest as the stochastic-floor dataset.

gap_2_isogenic_variance_floor.honest_caveat: AB/TL are inbred lab strains with RESIDUAL HETEROZYGOSITY, not strictly clonal — the study attributes the variance to a stochastic component 'among fish of the same genetic background'. The Neuron 2012 within-animal clones are the more rigorous fixed-genome floor. C32 is the only truly-isogenic line found but its data is not public. State this limitation in any variance-decomposition that uses this floor.
